title: The selected pullback composition comparison commutes with shifts
statement: The selected pullback composition comparison commutes with shifts. For chosen derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] and additive tensor pullbacks [def-pc-module-pullback], take any family of pullback integer shift comparisons compatible with the selected left-derived counits [lem-pc-pinned-pullback-counit-shifts]. For any composable f and g, the hom of the comparison selected by [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition] commutes with these shift comparisons.

source.place: The selected pullback composition comparison commutes with shifts; shift verification of the constructions, written by K4.

proof.text: precompose both proposed shift equations with the localization functor Qh and then postcompose with the selected counit of the composite pullback. The factorization of the selected left-derived lift identifies each side with the successive counits followed by the termwise composition comparison. The assumed shift equations for the counits and the shift equation for termwise tensor reassociation identify these expressions. The left-derived universal property makes the two lifted maps equal. This proves the equation for each integer; no cartesian, flatness or boundedness hypothesis enters.

lean.statement:
theorem pinnedPullbackComposition_commShift
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (k : Y ⟶ Z), (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback k).Additive]
    (s : ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y), (derivedPullback.{u, w} f).CommShift ℤ)
    (hs : ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y),
      letI := s f
      NatTrans.CommShift (pinnedPullbackCounit.{u, w} f) ℤ)
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    letI := s f
    letI := s g
    letI := s (f ≫ g)
    NatTrans.CommShift (pinnedPullbackComposition.{u, w} f g).hom ℤ
